recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-6920 in core unless a future work group decision changes the source-vs-author model for List.source.
issue_request: FHIR-6920 was a Published FHIR-core List change request from the 2015May ballot, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking to add Author support to List by adding "(Author)" to the List source short description and ensuring Author was present as an alias and in the formal definition.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied in svn revision 5797, imported as git commit 3b45db406bd920cdeea85fc93f42cec09c5568d6, which changed the legacy source/list/list-spreadsheet.xml List.source short description and definition. Later source refactors carried the same content into the current source/list/structuredefinition-List.xml file.
additional_context: The current build includes List as an active resource in source/fhir.ini. Duplicate trackers FHIR-7106 and FHIR-7312 asked for the same List.author capability and were closed as duplicates; later List.source tracker FHIR-22667 changed allowed target types without reversing the author/source wording.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/list/structuredefinition-List.xml already contains all three requested pieces: short description "(aka Author)", a formal definition that equates human-created list source with author, and alias Author.

related_jiras.note: Asked for the same optional List.author concept and was closed as a duplicate.
Asked to add List.author and records the duplicate rationale as making source = author alias more explicit.
